description: Tatiana was meant to be an ordinary girl, but after a tragic expedition, her mother decided to shape her destiny. The mother thought the current huntresses were not efficient enough. Therefore, she started training her daughter from her earliest childhood. This training was barbaric, and Tatiana survived it for a single reason: more than anything else, she wanted to see her mother smile. Unfortunately, the more efforts the child put in, the tougher the training became. Just before she joined the Academy, Tatiana reached her objective, but it did not matter anymore. Her mother smiled as she realised her work was done: Tatiana had become a skilled huntress whose only desire was to accomplish her missions. In the absence of feelings, what could she be afraid of in the future?
summon: Teamwork? Whatever, I'm waiting for my orders!
